goal: Complete all source, CRM architecture and website-construction work that does not require real clients, professional legal approval or a live provider execution.

states.source_ready: All repository, CRM architecture, website route, release-build and operating-template requirements pass.
states.construction_ready: A preview or staging website artifact can be built reproducibly with checksums and no source editing.
states.client_acquisition_ready: The website, CRM, service catalogue, qualification, delivery and evidence systems are ready to receive clients once activation gates are supplied.
states.live_intake_ready: All provider, privacy, legal, publication and human-release gates pass.
states.paid_delivery_ready: Legal identity, invoice route, payment terms and human commercial approval pass.
